starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: Time to dig. To dig, dig, dig. But no normal dig. We now have new purpose!

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.player: What do you mean? What purpose?

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: The brothers six! Dutiful servants of Saradomin... At least, that's what they'd tell you! Ha! Not so. Not so.

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: They made a pact you see! Strength in life for servitude in death.

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: Yes! They guard it for him! That was their purpose, but that time is up now. He wants it back! You can get it! You can dig!

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.player: You want me to bring you something?

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: The icon! He needs it now! You must dig, dig, dig. Slay the brothers six! It's okay, it won't hurt them... much. The icon will be in the chest!

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.player: Right... So you want me to go and kill the six brothers and bring you back an icon?

starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-the-strange-old-.text: Yes! Do this! Do this! Maybe little prize for you if you do. But first you must dig! Dig, dig, dig!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the brothers?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about the brothers?

steps.text: If the player does not have the crumbling tome in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Strange Old Man
steps.text: The brothers? His faithful servants! Book tell you more! Take it! I don't even want it!
The Strange Old Man gives you a book.
If the player has the crumbling tome in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Strange Old Man
steps.text: The brothers? His faithful servants! Book tell you more! Read it! Read it!

options.text: I wanted to ask you about warnings.

steps.player: I wanted to ask you about warnings.

steps.text: If the warnings are not combined:

steps.player: Currently when I'm trying to go plundering the catacombs here, my mind is plagued by several inconvenient warnings about the dangers below.
I was wondering, do you know of a way to condense these warnings into a single one?
Thanks for having those mental warnings I was having condensed into a single one, but I miss having them seperated.
Is there any chance you'd be willing to change it back for me?
I'm guessing that was a yes? In that case, thanks.

starting-out-talking-to-him-again-withou.speaker: Strange Old Man
starting-out-talking-to-him-again-withou.text: Slow! No slow! Only fast! Fast dig! Dig, dig, dig!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the brothers?
I wanted to ask you about warnings.

giving-the-strange-icon.text: You give the icon to the Strange Old Man.

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: You did it! Now for me.
Before you can react, the Strange Old Man casts a spell. The icon disintegrates in his hands.

giving-the-strange-icon.player: What? But why? I thought you needed it!

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: Yes! Needed it for him, but not to keep! His friend asked him to protect it, but he made a new plan, a better plan!

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: The old plan is gone. We're not doing it that way. His friend won't be happy, but it was for the best!

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: Now we're doing it his way...

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: Anyway, job well done! Still more digging though. Always dig. Dig, dig, dig!

giving-the-strange-icon.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon.text: Oh, and don't forget your prize! He made it very clear you had to have a prize!
The Strange Old Man gives you a lamp and a map.

giving-the-strange-icon-if-the-strange-o.player: Why did you destroy the icon? I though you needed it!

giving-the-strange-icon-if-the-player-cl.speaker: Strange Old Man
giving-the-strange-icon-if-the-player-cl.text: This is for you. Take it! Take it!
If the player has not claimed the lamp nor the map:

steps.text: The Strange Old Man has given you a lamp and a map.

giving-the-strange-icon-if-the-player-cl.text: If the player has not claimed the lamp:

steps.text: The Strange Old Man has given you a lamp.

giving-the-strange-icon-if-the-player-cl.text: If the player has not claimed the map:

steps.text: The Strange Old Man has given you a map.

options.text: Can you tell me more about the brothers?
I wanted to ask you about warnings.
I'll leave you to it then...

steps.player: I'll leave you to it then...
